Something to note is how White can improve 
slowly, while Black can't The move 24.id3 
clears e2 for the queen, prepares against ... f6-f5, 
and gives extra protection to the c2-square. 
Meanwhile, Black controls the c-file, but cannot 
do much with it. 
Less accurate is 24.if2 since Black immediately 
gains counterplay with 24 ... f5!. A possible 
continuation is 25 .id3 fxe4 26.fxe4 if6 27.a4 
ig5 and Black is closer to equality than in the 
game.
